build_dqn_model: build a FullyConnectedDQN model with state_dim, action_dim, hidden layer sizes, and activations for deep Q-learning
create_dqn_with_batch_norm: create a FullyConnectedDQN model with batch normalization enabled for stable training of Q-values
run_dqn_forward_pass: run a forward pass on FullyConnectedDQN with state FeatureData to get Q-values for all actions
test_dqn_action_masking: test FullyConnectedDQN forward pass with possible_actions_mask to mask invalid actions with INVALID_ACTION_CONSTANT
review_dqn_architecture: review the FullyConnectedDQN class that extends FloatFeatureFullyConnected for mapping states to scalar Q-values
